question.text: Paragraph: Let $U_1$ and $U_2$ be two urns such that $U_1$ contains 3 white and 2 red balls and $U_2$ contains only 1 white ball. A fair coin is tossed. If head appears then 1 ball is drawn at random from $U_1$ and put into $U_2$. However, if tail appears then 2 balls are drawn at random from $U_1$ and put into $U_2$. Now, 1 ball is drawn at random from $U_2$.Question: Given that the drawn ball from $U_2$ is white, the probability that head appeared on the coin is

solution.text:
$P$ (head appeared/white from $V_2$ )
$$
\begin{aligned}
& =P(H) \cdot \frac{\left\{\frac{{ }^3 C_1}{{ }^5 C_1} \times \frac{{ }^2 C_1}{{ }^2 C_1}+\frac{{ }^2 C_1}{{ }^5 C_1} \times \frac{{ }^1 C_1}{{ }^2 C_1}\right\}}{\frac{23}{30}} \\
& =\frac{1}{2} \frac{\left\{\frac{3}{5} \times 1+\frac{2}{5} \times \frac{1}{2}\right\}}{\frac{23}{30}}=\frac{12}{23} \\

\end{aligned}
